module: GE extension `core_inventory`: simple inventory for the campaign/scenarios. Stores per type (UPPERCASE key) either a numeric counter (money) or a list of objects (vehicles, parts). Provides functions to add, remove and read items, and interprets the `onEvent` blocks of the campaign files (rewards or losses depending on the medal earned).
usage:
core_inventory.addItem('$$$_MONEY', 200)
core_inventory.addItem('$$$_VEHICLE', {model='etk800', config='etk800_m', color='1 1 1 1'})
print(core_inventory.getItem('$$$_MONEY'))      -- 200 (the key must be uppercase)
local liste = core_inventory.getItemList('$$$_VEHICLE')
notes: Types are converted to UPPERCASE by addItem/removeItem, but NOT by getItem/getItemList: you must pass the type in uppercase (e.g. '$$$_MONEY') to read what you added.
A type containing numbers is a counter (addItem adds, removeItem subtracts, no lower limit); with a table, the type becomes a list. The first addition sets the nature of the type.

Duplicates: addItem of a table adds nothing if an existing element has ALL its fields equal to the corresponding fields of the new value (key-by-key comparison starting from the existing element). removeItem of a table deletes the first element whose model and config equal those of valueObj (the other fields are ignored).

processOnEvent: keys of an onEvent block: 'remove' (removes) or any other key (adds); the key is prefixed with '$$$_' and uppercased. In 'remove', the sub-keys 'gold'/'silver'/'bronze' are only applied if they equal earnedMedal; the other sub-keys are removed unconditionally.

Inconsistency: onSerialize returns a copy of itemsTable but onDeserialized is empty; after an extensions reload the inventory is therefore not restored by this mechanism (only onResumeCampaign reloads it). existItem returns nil (not false) for an empty list; getItem returns the last element found if several have the same itemId.

itemsTable.desc: Inventory: type (UPPERCASE) -> counter or list of objects.

addItem.desc: Adds to the inventory: sum of a number or insertion of an object (without duplicates). Ignored if itemType or valueObj is nil/false.

itemType.desc: Object type (converted to uppercase), by convention prefixed '$$$_'.

valueObj.desc: Quantity to add, or object (e.g. {model, config, color}).

removeItem.desc: Removes from the inventory: subtracts a number or deletes the object whose model and config match.

valueObj.desc: Quantity to remove, or object with model and config.

getItem.desc: Reads a type. For a counter returns its value (0 if absent); for a list returns a copy of the element whose itemId equals itemId.

itemId.desc: Value of the itemId field searched for (list only).

returns.desc: Quantity, copy of the element, or nil if not found in a list.

getItemList.desc: Deep copy of a type's list; creates an empty list for this type if absent (side effect).

returns.desc: Copy of the list (or of the numeric counter if it is a number).

processOnEvent.desc: Applies a campaign 'onEvent' block: direct 'add' keys (type -> value or list) and 'remove' block (by medal or unconditional).

onSaveCampaign.desc: Campaign save hook: calls saveCallback(extension alias, copy of itemsTable).

onResumeCampaign.desc: Campaign resume hook: replaces itemsTable with the saved data.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before extensions reload: returns a copy of itemsTable.
